paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption:
(a) IWSLT14 De→En

Translation quality (BLEU) v.s. latency (Average Lagging, AL) in Wait-k Policy.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different experimental conditions. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)," uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 9, with tick marks at intervals of 2 unit from 2. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," also uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 32, with tick marks at intervals of 2 units. The plot contains four lines. The purple line with circles, representing "Consistency-CE," is dashed and shows a steady increase from a BLEU score of less than 20 at AL 1 to around 31 at AL 8. The dark purple line with squares, representing "Inconsistency-CE," is also dashed and begins at a BLEU score of about 23 at AL 1, reaching around 31 at AL 8. The blue line with square markers, labeled "Inconsistency-CE-MP," is dashed and starts at a BLEU score of roughly 22 at AL 1, rising to about 32 at AL 8. Finally, the red line with star markers, representing "Consistency-Bi," is solid and climbs from a BLEU score of approximately 26 at AL 1 to over 32 at AL 8, showing a consistent upward trend. The blue dotted intersects the purple line at an x-value of 3, and the darker purple line at an x-value of 5. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
